blocks.text: CHARLOTTE, N.C.— Ty Jerome made seven 3-pointers and finished with 29 points, and the Memphis Grizzlies handed the Charlotte Hornets their fifth straight loss, 117-111 in the NBA on Monday night. Cam Spencer added 24 points and Cedric Coward had 16 points and nine rebounds for the Grizzlies, who limited the Hornets to 40% shooting from the field.
